metadata.llm_reason: Candidate is a distinct micro_skill for live DevTools-based CLS observation during user interaction. It differs semantically from peer candidates: 'Record Layout Shifts via Performance Observer' uses programmatic console-based capture (different method_family: javascript_observer vs. live_observation); 'Prefetch Content Before User Interaction' addresses content loading optimization (different task_family: content_loading); 'Configure Font Fallback Matching' addresses font metric alignment (different task_family: web_performance_optimization). Existing skills are framework-specific (Next.js Link, Script component) and do not overlap with this DevTools diagnostic technique. The candidate fills a gap in live, interactive CLS diagnosis during investigation stage.
